mechanics.claim: The shield absorbs magic damage only, and grants crowd control immunity while it holds.
mechanics.quote: which absorbs incoming {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while it holds

mechanics.claim: Black Shield negates crowd control effects before any magic damage is absorbed, even if the shield is broken by enough damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Black Shield'' negates {{tip|crowd control}} effects before any magic damage is absorbed; even if the shield is broken by an enemy dealing enough damage, its associated disables will not apply.

mechanics.claim: Black Shield can be cast on Morgana herself or an allied champion.
mechanics.quote: grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied {{tip|champion}} or herself
